overview.description: Raiganj Wildlife Sanctuary (Raegônj Bonnoprani Ôbhôearonno) (also popularly known as Kulik Bird Sanctuary) is situated near Raiganj in Uttar Dinajpur district in the Indian state of West Bengal. The bird sanctuary is home to 164 species of birds, and some 90,000 to 100,000 migratory birds visit the sanctuary every year. As per the MEE report, West Bengal''s Jaldapara national park and Raiganj wildlife sanctuary, Himachal Pradesh''s Sainj and Tirthan wildlife sanctuaries as well as the Great Himalayan national park have been declared as top five national parks and wildlife sanctuaries in India.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Raiganj Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The best time to visit Raiganj Wildlife Sanctuary is Oct – Mar. Summers are 25–42°C and winters are 7–24°C.

faq.a: The nearest airport is Raiganj Wildlife Sanctuary / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Katihar Junction (55 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.
